title: refactor(objectql): move the package registration bodies out of engine.ts into engine-package-registration.ts (#25522 cut 17)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5TDYgc33GQV9hiYvxWt8f8)_ Part of #25522 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6348891160 + 6441032442 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：把 `engine.ts` 里包注册区的三个方法体（`convertPackageBodyForward` 注册门的协议前向转换、`registerPlugin` 嵌套插件注册、`resolveNavObjectNames` 导航对象名解析）原样搬进新文件 `engine-package-registration.ts`；类上的方法签名、注释、位置不变，方法体换成转交。两者与留下的 `registerApp` 共用的 `stampPackage` / `stampObjectPackage` 原地加 `export`、由新文件导入（不复制）。`engine.ts` 21,733 → 21,661 行。 - **为什么改**：#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 17 刀。本区原定价 −233，但 #26337 落地时在 `packages/spec/liveness/` 里把 `engine.ts#registerMetadataCollections` 登记为生产者（18 处），它按系列规则留在原文件；剩下可搬的三个方法重定价 −75，仍高于 −30，按派单取本区。 - **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，无行为变化；公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件与基线逐字节相同（含正控）；运行期导出名单相同；构建产物里只多出新文件一个区段，外部包的导入顺序一条不差（新文件在 `engine.ts` 原先导入 `@objectstack/metadata-core` 的位置导入）；一次性晚绑定探针在新旧两版构建产物上逐行一致。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine-package-registration.ts`（三个函数与 `PackageRegistrationHost`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里三个转交桩、新的导入行与两处原地 `export`。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-nested-plugin-collections.test.ts src/registry-installed-package-retired-page-declarations.test.ts`，应见两个文件全部通过（嵌套插件注册与注册门前向转换各自的测试）。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 Cut 17 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`), under the claim `6450667239`. Three bodies of the "Package, app, plugin and driver registration" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-package-registration.ts`, behind `PackageRegistrationHost`: `convertPackageBodyForward` (ADR-0087 D2's forward conversion at the package registration door), `registerPlugin` (a nested plugin's objects, plugin-as-app and stack collections, registered under its parent package) and `resolveNavObjectNames` (the navigation `objectName` resolution). No behaviour changes. Every published declaration file is byte-identical to the base. #25522 stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/project-thread-y39a3j` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `e1bfde3601`, which contains cut 16's merge (`d8b943b620`, #26792) and #26337. ## What changes ### Why this area, and why it now pays -75 and not -233 Re-measured on `e1bfde3601` with cut 11's measure script and cut 14's price step (`price3.mjs`), both unchanged. `engine.ts` is 21,733 lines, 6,745 of them from the last 30 days (`git blame --since=2026-09-27T18:45Z`, clone deepened to 2026-09-21 first); `class ObjectQL` holds 324 members, 259 methods and accessors. Query-options erasure sites: 8 at base (lines 8372, 9690, 9936, 10000, 10332, 13612, 13911, 18522), none in this area. Cut 16's table priced the section at -233 with four bodies, `registerMetadataCollections` (166 body lines) the largest. #26337, the PR that held the section out, landed with 18 producer pointers `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#registerMetadataCollections` in `packages/spec/liveness/queue.json` (6) and `assignment_rule.json` (12). A body named by an `engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec` stays in this series, and the claim forbids `packages/spec/**` edits, so `registerMetadataCollections` stays, and with it `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`, `resolveMetadataItemName` and `permissionSetOwnerRegistrationRefusal` (its helpers) and the `check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` row that names `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` in `engine.ts`. `registerApp` and `registerDriver` stay as the order says (public, inferred return type). The other three re-price at **-75**. That still pays more than -30, so under the order this cut takes the section rather than the fallback (Delete cascade and reference walking, -124). It is also the colder of the two: 36 of 98 body lines from the last 30 days, against 128 of 167.

| price (net lines) | section | taken? | |---|---|---| | -233 priced at `fe53769a8e`, **-75 re-priced**, **-72 landed** | Package, app, plugin and driver registration | **yes** (`convertPackageBodyForward` 28 body lines, `resolveNavObjectNames` 15, `registerPlugin` 55; `registerMetadataCollections` stays, pointed at from `packages/spec/liveness/`) | | -124 | Delete cascade and reference walking | no: the order takes the registration section while it pays more than -30 | | -71 or less | count / aggregate, Query lowering, the rest | pays less | | -27 | `resolveFormulaRelated` | a later cut, as the order says | ### The shape - The class keeps each of the three methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. A body becomes one host literal of exactly the `PackageRegistrationHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 17]`, as cuts 8 and 10 to 16 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`registrationConversionWarned`, `logger`, `_registry`); methods go as late-bound closures (`resolveNavObjectNames`, `registerMetadataCollections`), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches. `resolveNavObjectNames` reads no member, so its stub calls the function directly. No body assigns a field (`registrationConversionWarned.add(` mutates the set the getter returns, the same object), so there is no setter. - **Series limits.** `convertPackageBodyForward` is public with a declared return type (`any`); `registerPlugin` and `resolveNavObjectNames` are private, so their `.d.ts` line is `private NAME;` either way. No moved body has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, a private-static read, a self-call to `insert` / `update` / `delete`, an `engine.ts#NAME` pointer or an ADR anchor paragraph of its own. - **Helpers, under the cut-14 seat ruling.** `registerPlugin` reads two top-level helpers, both also read by bodies that stay: `stampObjectPackage` (`registerApp`) and `stampPackage` (`registerApp`, `registerMetadataCollections`, `stampObjectPackage`). Both gain `export` in place, byte for byte otherwise (leading docblocks included), and the module imports them as values from `./engine.js`; nothing is copied. Measured alone before the move (`dts-export-variant-cut17.sh`, base engine.ts plus the `export`, no move): each export and both together leave all published declaration files byte-identical. `index.ts` and `core.ts` name their exports singly, so nothing new is published. - **The run-time cycle and the load order (measured).** The value import makes `engine.ts` and the module import each other. The module runs nothing at evaluation (declarations only). The moved `convertPackageBodyForward` was `engine.ts`'s only reader of `@objectstack/metadata-core`, so that import line leaves `engine.ts` with it. The first build imported the module after `./engine-validate.js` (the cut-16 position); that kept the internal module order but moved `@objectstack/metadata-core`'s first import in the ESM bundles three externals later (after `@objectstack/metadata/view-container`, `ajv`, `ajv-formats`). So the module is imported exactly where `engine.ts` imported `@objectstack/metadata-core`. The module's other imports (`./registry.js`, `./engine.js`, a type from `@objectstack/spec/data`) are already loaded by then: the bundles place `registry.ts` long before that region. Measured on the built bundles (`bundlecmp.py`; `index.mjs`, `core.mjs`, `index.js`, `core.js`): with the `// src/engine.ts` markers set aside (9 at base, 10 at head, because the new region splits one), the `// src/...` region order at head equals the base's with one line added, `// src/engine-package-registration.ts`, inside the `engine.ts` region where the import sat. Every external `import` statement (113 and 96 in the ESM bundles) and every `require(` call (148 and 130 in the CJS bundles) is identical and in the same order. The late-binding probe answers the same on base and head (Tests). - **Imports.** The module imports `ServiceObject` (type), `applyArtifactForwardConversions` and `resolveDeclaredRange` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`), `computeFQN` (`./registry.js`), `stampObjectPackage` and `stampPackage` (values) and `ObjectQL` (type) from `./engine.js`. `engine.ts` loses the `@objectstack/metadata-core` import line (its last reader moved) and `computeFQN` from the `./registry.js` line (likewise). - The module header names what moved, how the bodies reach the class, why `registerApp`, `registerMetadataCollections` and `registerDriver` stay, and how the helpers were handled. ### Net lines (the seat's rule) `engine.ts` goes from 21,733 to 21,661 lines, **net -72** (30 added, 102 removed). The module is 192 lines. The diff against `origin/main` is 324 changed lines over 2 files (+222 / -102). ### Readers of the moved lines - No census, ADR anchor, docs row or test key names a moved member by `engine.ts` path. Searched: `engine.ts#NAME` and `engine.ts … NAME` spellings of all three methods, the two helpers, `registrationConversionWarned`, `applyArtifactForwardConversions`, `resolveDeclaredRange` and `computeFQN` under `packages/**`, `scripts/**`, `docs/**` and `content/**`: none. The prose mentions found (`packages/cli/src/**` comments, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, ADR-0029 line 559) name `registerApp`, `registerMetadataCollections`, `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` or `computeFQN`'s behaviour, not a moved body. - `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`'s `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` row reads `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, where the constant stays (it is `registerMetadataCollections`' helper), so it does not move. The gate is green at head. - The bodies call no `canReadObject(` (core's `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` is unchanged), no `referenceTargetOf(` (`second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` is unchanged), no `isFederatedObject` / `resolveTenantFieldName` (`federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys none), and read no `isSystem` (`system-context.mdx` is unchanged; its census is green). They hold no `query-options/no-any-erasure` site and no tenant-audit untyped receiver. - **No ADR anchor paragraph describes a moved body** (the `engine.ts` entry is the transaction-seam paragraph), so the module needs no anchor entry of its own. - **Read-seam census (the cut-21 trap of #25467).** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` at base and head: identical once line numbers are masked (164 lines: 48 durability seams and 88 read seams, the same entries); none of the moved names appears. - **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `e1bfde3601` (clean detached worktree): **1,898** decision-letter citations on the anchored surface, 59,997 resolving citations across 8,409 files. At head: **1,898**, 59,998 across 8,410 (the new module: one more file, and the header's `ADR-0087 D2`). The moved bodies cite ADR-0087, ADR-0010 and ADR-0122 without a decision letter, so no letter leaves the anchored surface. ## Why #25522 splits `engine.ts` one seam at a time so that a change to one area reads, reviews and conflicts as that area alone. The registration section was next in cut 16's table and was held out only for #26337, which has landed. Nothing about what the engine does changes. ## Tests No test is added and none is edited: the move is proved by identity, not by new behaviour, and no test reads a moved line by path.

Every declaration file is **raw byte-identical** base to head, so `6348891160` item 1 holds without any normalisation, and no chunk is renamed (`util-DdsJlVTF` at both). The `6441032442` block, for the record (normaliser `pm-orders/server/evidence/25522/dtsnorm.mjs`, sha256 `25226e0677bdad24726e9eff76a7e247bf7319440d2430d28cbaab0db6add94b`, run as `node dtsnorm.mjs --diff BASE_FILE HEAD_FILE`): | file | raw sha256 (base = head) | raw-diff lines | statements base / head | normalised sha256 (base = head) | declared-surface digest (base = head) | import / export specifier sets | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | `core.d.ts` | `642b5a3662c27aabde2dae4bb5877f515cb89f4c1e8075f21c0598b7e6025206` | 0 | 14 / 14 | `40e2fde86719d3ccd1cf492314c426c977ab836a5ab54580800cd1f41352247a` | `4450aaf478092516…` (1 decl) EQUAL | 0 / 84, EQUAL | | `core.d.mts` | `07f5718a09a2662c2f94bc3d79a8e74b67310efa82071a5d81ed1b716adaa69c` | 0 | 14 / 14 | `171eab8743fd8dfabc014a162c40c3e034be29f262b26a2bcc24cb3e06be0459` | `4450aaf478092516…` EQUAL | 0 / 84, EQUAL | | `index.d.ts` | `6dd970eb9c7dc4364e2fe99d22460672edc270302287f812231d823090491122` | 0 | 122 / 122 | `2bb6a21a929b41c8dbb85c72c600f87ed3a3af12ca731d1cace61f5d4aa3d57e` | `9136189ce4d0aba3…` (103 decls) EQUAL | 18 / 284, EQUAL | | `index.d.mts` | `37153868b48bef0e9ad655d74b549a30f51510977cb704e0d6624db1d8e83781` | 0 | 122 / 122 | `c7d7bab765f3b0fb35241fa03bd0b716a93139c98e5638d209379dad96528f98` | `9136189ce4d0aba3…` EQUAL | 18 / 284, EQUAL | | `util-DdsJlVTF.d.ts` | `856d98e0e45ced3ec15bf72a1ac09420a2c4f73b5165ab598c1d7d0000705f02` | 0 | 185 / 185 | `a4372dd015163a46e90b82473d806423a5ca982b8bef21e6e8bfed2b0655b9dd` | `71a464127e0b90b1…` (173 decls) EQUAL | 55 / 147, EQUAL | | `util-DdsJlVTF.d.mts` | `856d98e0e45ced3ec15bf72a1ac09420a2c4f73b5165ab598c1d7d0000705f02` | 0 | 185 / 185 | `a4372dd015163a46e90b82473d806423a5ca982b8bef21e6e8bfed2b0655b9dd` | `71a464127e0b90b1…` EQUAL | 55 / 147, EQUAL | - (a) Every file: statements in the same order, `statements only in base: 0; only in head: 0`, declared-surface digest EQUAL. (b) Every normalised sha256 EQUAL. (c) Specifier sets EQUAL; the run-time export lists are too (`index` 182 names and `core` 54, ESM and CJS, the same sorted list at base and head). (d) Raw diff: 0 lines in every file; the same 14 files in `dist/` at both. (e) After the head build, the full `turbo run build` (116 of 116 tasks, the dependents' DTS builds included) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck` ran on the head `dist/`: exit 0 each. - Premises re-checked at this head: (P2) `packages/objectql/package.json` `exports` names `./dist/index.*` and `./dist/core.*` only, `driver-sql`'s `./dist/index.*` only; (P3) `git grep -n -E 'objectql/dist|driver-sql/dist' -- scripts package.json`: 0 hits. - **Each in-place export alone, before the move** (`dts-export-variant-cut17.sh`, base `engine.ts` with only `export` added): `none`, `stampObjectPackage`, `stampPackage`, and both together all print the same `util-DdsJlVTF.d.ts`, `index.d.ts` `6dd970eb9c7d…` and `core.d.ts` `642b5a3662c2…`. **Positive control.** On this head, one `sed` dropped `private` from ` private registerPlugin(` (a moved member's stub; anchor count 1 to 0, replacement count 0 to 1; `engine.ts` blob `f9aa217bc55d` to `7c36c1c279c1`) and rebuilt (`posctl17.sh`, build exit 0). The chunk is renamed `util-Xhg7Kcdw` and now publishes `registerPlugin(plugin: any, parentId: string, parentNamespace?: string, parentVersion?: string): void;` (line 7555); its normalised sha256 is `668033198231cb9bda8545cd23975b0ce61c92a81952ef2dc84f8f692e694852` ≠ `a4372dd0…`, its declared-surface digest `a2448d3c517a96ad…` ≠ `71a464127e0b90b1…` (the `declare class ObjectQL` statement named as the one changed), and the raw `core.d.ts` (`d1b150bdbefd…`) and `index.d.ts` (`ac50bb3fc445…`) change with the chunk name. `index.d.ts` normalises EQUAL under the control (an entry only re-exports), which is why every declaration file is read. The restore leg put the blob back to `f9aa217bc55d` (`git diff HEAD` empty), and `@objectstack/objectql` was rebuilt and its chunk compared equal to the head build before anything else read `dist/`.
AST compare (move-only) `astcmp.mjs` (TypeScript compiler API, comments and whitespace ignored, tokens compared) on base `engine.ts` against head `engine.ts` plus the module: - The three moved bodies are **SAME** against base `e1bfde3601` (parameters, return type, `async`, body tokens, and every body line equal after one level of indent): `convertPackageBodyForward` 309 tokens / 28 lines, `resolveNavObjectNames` 122 / 15, `registerPlugin` 367 / 55. - `class ObjectQL`: 324 of 324 members kept, in the same order; 321 byte-identical, and the 3 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature identical. - Top level: 229 of 234 base statements byte-identical. The other 5 (`exportcmp.mjs`): the `@objectstack/metadata-core` import, moved verbatim to the module; the `./registry.js` import, which loses `computeFQN`; `stampPackage` and `stampObjectPackage`, exported in place with statement and leading docblock otherwise identical; and the class. The head adds one statement: the module import.
Load order (base and head bundles) `bundlecmp.py` on the four built bundles. `// src/engine.ts` markers set aside (9 at base, 10 at head: the new region splits one), the region order at head is the base's plus `// src/engine-package-registration.ts`, everything else in order (`index.mjs` 98 to 99 regions, `core.mjs` 87 to 88, `index.js` 99 to 100, `core.js` 88 to 89).
